name: Rattler drive Mk I
description: Pulled from a wrecked fighter and bench-tested twice. It runs rough but it runs.

name: Rattler drive Mk II
description: Rebuilt with a new injector and old gaskets. Settles after a minute.

name: Rattler drive Mk III
description: Run hotter than the plate says. The nozzle is a different colour from the rest.

name: Clatterbox drive Mk I
description: A drive from a dead explorer with one cracked chamber taped off. Strong and a bit lopsided.

name: Clatterbox drive Mk II
description: Refurbished by a yard crew who did not sign the work. Smoother than it has any right to be.

name: Clatterbox drive Mk III
description: Overbored and re-lined. Shakes the cabin on the climb and pulls like a mule.

name: Wheezer drive Mk I
description: Cut out of a gunship hull with the mounts still welded on. Pulls well, vents oddly.

name: Wheezer drive Mk II
description: Refurbished and re-badged. The serial plates disagree with each other.

name: Wheezer drive Mk III
description: Reconditioned past its rated life. Breakers swear by it and nobody else is asked.

name: Bellower drive Mk I
description: Two half engines fused into one block. Loud, heavy and quite willing.

name: Bellower drive Mk II
description: Refurbished tug drive, with the tow-hook scars still on the casing.

name: Bellower drive Mk III
description: A hauler drive pushed well past its limits. The warranty is a rumour.

name: Long Cough drive Mk I
description: A freighter main drive dragged out of a derelict and made to work again.

name: Long Cough drive Mk II
description: Refurbished main drive with a bolted collar where the crack used to be.

name: Long Cough drive Mk III
description: Stripped, rebuilt and over-fuelled. It will move anything and complain about all of it.

name: Gutter plant Mk I
description: Salvaged cells wired in parallel. Charges quickly and holds less than it should.

name: Gutter plant Mk II
description: Refurbished and balanced against its own surges. The lights dim when the guns fire.

name: Gutter plant Mk III
description: Reconditioned reactor with a bypass nobody will explain. It flickers green at the casing.

description: Hull plate fields wired to a salvaged emitter. Soaks a lot and takes its time to come back.

name: Tarp shield Mk II
description: Refurbished emitter ring. Holds well and sulks after a hit.

name: Tarp shield Mk III
description: Reconditioned and over-driven. Deep reserve, slow to recover, loud when it fails.

name: Whisker sensor Mk II

name: Whisker sensor Mk III
description: Reconditioned array with a second dish bolted on for luck.

name: Scrap cannon S1 Mk I
description: A cannon welded from wreck barrels. It fires scrap, and the scrap hurts.

name: Harpoon slug S1 Mk I
description: A winch gun with a barbed slug on a stub of cable. The cable is mostly for show.

name: Scrap cannon S1 Mk II
description: Refurbished breech and a new firing pin. Still fires scrap.

name: Harpoon slug S1 Mk II
description: Refurbished winch and a straighter rail. Hits what it aims at, mostly.

name: Scrap cannon S1 Mk III
description: Reconditioned and over-charged. Sprays hot slag in a wide, ugly cone.

name: Harpoon slug S1 Mk III
description: Reconditioned with a magnetic rail from a mining rig. The slugs punch right through light plate.

name: Smuggler's compartment
description: A sealed void behind a false bulkhead. Cargo scanners read it as hull.

name: Smuggler's compartment, large
description: A fuel tank that has never held fuel. Big enough for a pallet and a stowaway.

name: Salvage grapple
description: A cable winch with a four-clawed hook. Hauls drifting cargo and wreckage aboard from a distance.

name: Salvage grapple, heavy
description: Two winches, a magnetic clamp and a lot of faith. Drags whole hull sections into the hold.

name: Wreck cutter
description: A plasma lance on a boom. Slices wrecks into hold-sized pieces and pays out more than the same wreck would otherwise.

name: Patch kit
description: Plate offcuts, sealant and a welding torch on a bracket. Repairs hull damage in flight, badly.

name: Spare plate
description: Another ship's armour bolted over the first ship's armour. Adds hull points and mass.
